messages:
omar: FYI ACME pushed a replay last night that overlapped our nightly ingest. Ledger shows negative deltas and a few customers see transient double credits. Can someone triage?

katie: Do we have sample payloads? Could be duplicate events with new event_ids.

acme-ing-engineer: Apologies 10 we ran a backfill that retried on 429s and re-posted ~3k events with new uuids. Sample payload: ```json
{"customer_id":"cust-42","usage":1200,"timestamp":"2026-03-12T00:00:00Z","event_id":"evt-ABCD1234"}
```

claire: From reconciliation: same entitlement fingerprint but differing event_ids -> our dedupe missed them. We have ~14 affected accounts with net negative deltas.

sam: Support flagged 2 customers who paused features. Need an ETA + customer note ASAP.

omar: Proposed steps: (1) create an exception ticket and assign to Billing Ops for manual reconcile/credits, (2) patch ingest to reject partner replays lacking a replay_id header, returning 422, (3) add a short partner replay runbook. Thoughts? @billing-ops-bot create-ticket.

billing-ops-bot: New exception ticket created: EX-2026-342. Assigned to @claire. SLA 48h.

claire: I'll take EX-2026-342. First: get list of affected cust_ids and run a dry-run reconcile (pre-replay snapshot vs post). If net < 0 for account, queue manual reversal with audit id. Need CSV of event ids from partner.

acme-ing-engineer: Sending CSV now and will disable the backfill. We'll add a replay_id header and stop auto-uuid changes on retries. Sorry for the disruption.

katie: I'll scope a short ingest guard: detect replay window + absence of replay_id -> reject 422 with clear error message. Will aim to patch in a couple hours. Also adding a short-term metric: replay_rate > 0.05% triggers partner-integration alert.

sam: Drafting customer-facing note: apology, impact (billing portal shows mismatch), remediation steps, ETA for credits. Will post to #support-drafts in 20m.

claire: Dry-run done. Summary: 14 accounts affected, total over-credited tokens ~18,400. I'll attach SQL diff and reversal plan to EX-2026-342 before applying.

omar: Action items recap: @acme-ing-engineer sent CSV + disabled backfill, @katie implement ingest guard (P0), @claire run and apply manual reconciles, @sam publish customer note. I'll follow up with ACME PM to update integration checklist.

katie: Note: we should also update partner docs to require replay_id and include example curl with header. I'll add to the Partner Integration Spec and notify partner onboarding.

claire: Applying reversals now (with audit IDs attached). Will keep ticket open for 48h to validate no residual drift.

sam: Two customers confirmed receipt of the note and are unpaused.

omar: Closing loop 10 ACME rolled out the replay_id header and their client now respects idempotency on retries. Keeping EX-2026-342 open for monitoring. Thanks team :thumbsup:
